About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Orders team, you will shape the overall architecture, technical direction, and scalability of our core order-handling engine. The Orders domain is central to Instabee’s operations, processing deliveries for millions of consumers across Europe.
In this role, you’ll take on a high-leverage technical leadership position—driving architectural decisions, integrating modern technologies, and elevating engineering standards across our distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Architect Core Systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and resilience of our high-throughput order backbone.

Integrate AI & Modern Tech: Proactively adopt AI tools, LLMs, and smart automations to boost system capabilities and developer workflows.

Drive Strategy & Mentorship: Partner with product leaders to align tech roadmaps with business goals while coaching junior and mid-level engineers.

Continuous Optimization: Audit, refactor, and evolve our distributed microservices to ensure top-tier reliability and performance.

Collaborative Engineering: Champion technical excellence through high-standard code reviews, mob/pair programming, and shared ownership.

Your Future Team
The Orders team builds and maintains the core engine responsible for the end-to-end order lifecycle—from creation to successful delivery. Supported by an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Staff Engineer, you will operate with high autonomy in a tight-knit, collaborative environment where your technical decisions carry direct, company-wide impact.
What We’re Looking For
Senior Backend Background: Solid track record of architecting and operating resilient, high-throughput distributed systems in production.

Core Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

Databases: Advanced experience with MongoDB (or similar NoSQL/relational systems), including query optimization and schema design at scale.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and hands-on experience with GCP (or equivalent cloud environments).

AI-Forward Mindset: Practical curiosity for applying AI tooling and developer automations to streamline engineering and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership: Ability to take complex initiatives from concept to production while communicating architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical peers.

Fluency in English: Confident verbal and written communication.

(We value curiosity, problem-solving, and adaptability over ticking every single stack requirement on day one.)
What We Offer
Significant architectural ownership within one of the Nordics' most high-volume logistics platforms.

A culture of technical ambition, continuous learning, and minimal bureaucracy.

A supportive, senior engineering peer group focused on code quality and innovation.

Perks & Benefits:

🏢 Brand-New Office: Modern collaborative workspace in our new Stockholm HQ.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Designated dog-friendly areas throughout the office.

🏓 Fun & Games: Foosball, shuffleboard, table tennis, and an in-house karaoke room.

👶 Parental Top-Up: 6 months of parental pay support.

🎂 Birthday Off: An extra paid day off each year to celebrate your birthday.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup: Flexible working hours tailored to balance life and work.

About Instabee
Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.
As part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden, mandatory confidential background checks are conducted via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys.

Senior Wiring & Harness Engineer
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Company: Integro Consulting
Assignment: Client project within Automotive development
About the Role
Integro Consulting is looking for a Senior Wiring & Harness Engineer to join our client's team in Gothenburg. In this role, you will contribute to the development of electrical wiring harnesses and installation solutions for buses, ensuring that designs meet technical requirements, packaging constraints and project specifications.
You will work closely with project teams and other engineers within Platform Development to develop new solutions, improve existing designs and ensure high-quality technical documentation. The role also involves taking the lead in component installation and media routing activities, contributing your technical expertise and supporting project teams in solving complex engineering challenges.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop electrical wiring harnesses and installation solutions for buses.
Lead and support component installation and media routing activities.
Develop and document new design solutions using KAP and CATIA V5.
Investigate and evaluate existing and new technical solutions documented in KOLA and CATIA.
Perform electrical wiring design using Saber, including 2D wiring design.
Develop and manage routing and packaging solutions for electrical wiring harnesses and power cables.
Work with other media routing requirements, including pneumatic pipes and brake hoses.
Support PIL activities and implement design adjustments throughout the project lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with project teams and Platform Development to ensure that solutions meet technical requirements and project objectives.
Take ownership of technical challenges and lead activities when required.

Qualifications and Experience
We are looking for a technically strong and detail-oriented engineer with the ability to take responsibility and drive engineering activities forward.
Required qualifications:
A master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field, and/or several years of relevant professional experience.
Strong knowledge of Saber for 2D wiring design.
Good knowledge of CATIA V5, particularly electrical wiring harness and power cable routing and packaging.
Experience with media routing solutions, such as electrical harnesses, pneumatic pipes or brake hoses.
Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach to engineering.
A high level of commitment, accuracy and ownership.
Leadership skills and the ability to take the lead in technical activities and projects.
Professional fluency in English.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience working with Volvo Group systems and development processes.
Familiarity with KOLA and related engineering documentation.
Experience developing and maintaining electrical installation solutions in complex vehicle development projects.

Who You Are
You are an experienced engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with complex engineering challenges, investigating technical solutions and ensuring that every detail meets the required standards.
You are comfortable taking the lead when needed, collaborating across engineering teams and driving activities forward in a structured and professional manner.
If you have a strong background in electrical wiring design and enjoy taking ownership of technical solutions, we would like to hear from you.
Apply Now
Are you ready for your next engineering challenge?
Submit your CV and tell us how your experience in wiring harness design, Saber and CATIA V5 could contribute to this assignment.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Principal Software Engineer – TypeScript, Node.js & Azure Cloud
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer for an exciting consulting opportunity with a leading organisation in connected mobility and digital services in Gothenburg, Sweden.
Are you passionate about building scalable software, solving complex engineering challenges, and improving how digital products are developed and operated? Join an experienced engineering team building reliable digital foundations that support connected services for vehicle owners, dealers, and other customers.
🔧 About the Role
You will work as a hands-on software engineer, designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications and services. You will tackle challenging problems involving APIs, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems while helping shape technical architecture and engineering practices.
The team values collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of production services.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate high-quality software.
Build and maintain scalable services using TypeScript and Node.js.
Develop cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure.
Design and improve APIs, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems.
Contribute to architectural decisions and technical discussions with engineers and solution architects.
Improve application scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.
Strengthen automated testing, monitoring, observability, and DevOps practices.
Simplify complex solutions and reduce unnecessary technical complexity.
Take shared responsibility for operating, supporting, and continuously improving production services.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices.

✅ Required Skills & Experience
Extensive experience in software engineering and delivering production-grade applications and services.
Strong knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js.
Solid experience developing and operating cloud-native services in Microsoft Azure.
Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and data flows.
Experience with GraphQL or similar API technologies.
Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to solve complex technical problems.
A focus on clean, maintainable, and reliable software.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
University degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
A valid work permit for Sweden, if you are not an EU citizen.

⭐ Nice to Have
Experience with additional cloud technologies and distributed architectures.
Knowledge of infrastructure automation and cloud engineering best practices.
Experience improving observability, production reliability, and software delivery workflows.
Swedish language skills.

📍 Assignment Details
📌 Role: Principal Software Engineer
📍 Location: Lindholmen Science Park, Gothenburg, Sweden
🏢 Work Model: Hybrid – at least 3 days per week in the office
🛠️ Core Technologies: TypeScript, Node.js, Microsoft Azure, GraphQL, APIs, distributed systems
💼 Focus Areas: Cloud-native development, software architecture, scalability, reliability, and DevOps

We are looking for a curious, collaborative, and technically strong engineer who enjoys challenging existing solutions and finding simpler, more maintainable approaches. You should be comfortable remaining hands-on while contributing to architectural decisions, supporting production systems, and helping other engineers grow.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Refrigeration Circuit Engineering Department
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort

We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of this internship, you will engage in a diverse range of tasks, including:
Improving products by testing prototypes and/or serial appliances
Taking responsibility and contributing by coordinating project related topics
Supporting the team and development projects with analytical studies or simulations
Spreading and conserving knowledge by presenting and documenting test results or project findings
Involving yourself in research by studying and assessing new development ideas
Being creative and preparing or participating in development project related workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Mechanical Engineering or equivalent in the Bachelor's or Master's
Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to take on responsibility and drive work within your own initiative
Effective communication, teamwork abilities and comfortable working in an international team environment
Eagerness to learn and grow outside your field of studies
Strong logical reasoning and attention to detail
Critical thinking to analyze complex problems and dependencies
Knowledge in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and refrigeration
Able to write engineering grade technical documentation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project)
Basic knowledge of Matlab/Simulink is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.description:
The opportunity
HVDC Warranty & Base Services department deals directly with our already commissioned sites to provide support and problem solving for all issues related to the HVDC Control & Protection systems and Operational Technology (IT Infrastructure).
We also deliver new services and modifications to their existing control and protection systems to improve their user experience and to help customers meet new requirements in a fast-paced environment.
Come and join our team of driven engineers and senior experts, and you can expect an equally exciting and ever-changing time ahead of you.
How you´ll make an impact
Develop and implement design solutions for our diverse install base of HVDC Control & Protection systems and Operational Technology
Perform changes, implement and verify our Control & Protection solutions – executed in test labs and on site
Collaborating with our customers to fault-trace issues and prepare technical solutions for existing operational HVDC stations worldwide
Collaborating with a broader team and stakeholder of like-minded co-workers and experts to give the best results to our customers

Your background
You may hold a university degree applicable to the work within HVDC Control and Protection systems (e.g. Electrical Engineering, IT systems, Operational Technology, Computer Science), or have work experience from similar roles.
Background or education Power systems engineering and protection systems is beneficial
Equally important is your inner drive, and ability to get things done. For us, that means that you are a driven problem solver who eagerly takes on new tasks and enjoys the challenges of engineering

What will you do?
As a Senior Android Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel Android app. We are in the middle of migrating from Java to Kotlin and Jetpack Compose while continuously shipping product features to a global user base.
You’ll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our Android platform.
Areas of ownership:

Drive the migration from Java to a modern Kotlin + Compose stack

Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt

Build and modernize Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose

Contribute to architecture decisions (MVVM/MVI, Coroutines, platform improvements)

Collaborate closely with iOS, Web, Product, Design, and QA to ship the right solutions

Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed

Maintain and improve the overall health of the Android platform

Requirements:

You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office

5+ years of experience building Android applications

Strong knowledge of Kotlin (and solid Java understanding)

Experience with modern Android architecture (Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, MVVM/MVI)

Proven ability to work independently and ship high-quality code

You care about the code you leave behind — you ship features without cutting corners

You prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over clever complexity

Experience migrating legacy Android codebases to modern stacks

Experience with mobile CI/CD, testing, or DevOps practices is a plus

It's a plus with experience with collaborating across platforms (iOS/Web)

Why Rebtel?
Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:

Pension Plan

Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance

Dental Insurance

Occupational insurance

Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)

Discount on gym memberships

Bonus program

Extra parental pay

30 days annual vacation

Monday breakfasts

Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.

We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About Bodycote
At Bodycote, we’re more than the world’s leading provider of heat treatment and specialist thermal processing services. We’re a people business at heart. Our commitment to innovation and sustainability shapes everything we do. With a global footprint and a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact. Sustainability is central to our future. We’re on an ambitious journey to reduce our environmental impact through advanced technologies, smarter processes, and ongoing innovation, with our teams around the world playing a key role in making that happen.
The Role
As a Material Testing Lab Technician, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of materials through testing, analysis, and reporting. You will prepare and test material samples, operate and maintain laboratory equipment, and use digital tools to record and evaluate test results.
You will work closely with the Laboratory Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to support quality assurance, product development, and continuous improvement activities. In addition to conducting standardized tests, you will help maintain laboratory equipment, contribute to the accuracy and integrity of laboratory data, and ensure that all work is carried out in accordance with established safety and quality standards.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys practical laboratory work, has a keen eye for detail, and takes pride in producing accurate and reliable results.
Responsibilities
• Sample Preparation: Collect, handle, and prepare physical samples for testing.
• Conducting Tests: Perform standardized physical, mechanical, and minor chemical tests (e.g., strength, hardness, density, and corrosion properties) using digital tools and laboratory machinery.
• Equipment Maintenance: Clean, maintain, and calibrate testing devices regularly to ensure accuracy.
• Data Analysis & Reporting: Record test results, analyze data for compliance or failure causes, and draft technical reports.
• Safety Compliance: Follow strict laboratory safety protocols and wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
Who We’re Looking For
We’re looking for someone who brings:

A technical high school diploma or similar

Experience in materials testing and laboratory testing within the metals or manufacturing industry.

Familiarity of relevant standards and quality requirements, including ISO 9001 and ISO 17025.

Excellent ability to document, analyse and report technical results.

Good command of both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

Basic math and computer proficiency

What’s In It for You

Career progression opportunities within a global business

Exposure to operational development and continuous improvement initiatives 

A supportive, inclusive culture where your growth and development matter 

The opportunity to play a key role in daily operations and team performance 

Competitive salary and benefits package 

Location & Work Pattern
This role is a full time, permanent position based in Västerås, with onsite expectations. Some travel may be required depending on business needs.
Ready to Apply?
If you’re ready to join Bodycote and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and start your journey with us.
We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of characteristics protected by local law, including (where applicable) gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, and ethnic origin. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Industry
Information Technology and Services, Computer Software, and Internet
Netlight Consulting is looking for professionals with high ambitions and the potential to become our next top consultants.
Job description
As a consultant at Netlight you will collaborate with top talented colleagues together with market leading clients. A Netlight consultant works with solving complex business critical challenges which demand excellence in innovative thinking and teamwork.
You will be working in an international networking organization and will have access to knowledge from Netlight’s consultants all across Europe. Projects range within competencies such as Frontend development, Backend development, Fullstack Development, Architecture, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, DevOps, Infrastructure, Test Automation, Agile coaching, Project Management, Product Ownership/Management, UX-/UI-/Interaction design and IT Strategy.

Xensam: Join the Future of SAM Xensam is the leader in AI-powered, cloud-based Software Asset Management. Our technology brings clarity to complex IT environments, helping users make smart, data-driven decisions and maximize software ROI.
Recognized with the Highest Growth Award and ranked #3 Overall Champion at the Main Software 50 Awards Nordics, we’re scaling fast and looking for people who want to join the journey. At Xensam, you play a key role in a team built on energy, focus, and positivity. We value experience, but even more, the person behind it.
Together, we build the future of SAM.
About the role
As a Renewal Manager at Xensam, you will play a key role in driving our recurring revenue and long-term customer success. You will be responsible for managing the full renewal lifecycle for a portfolio of customers, ensuring high retention rates while identifying opportunities for expansion and growth.
In this role, you will build strong, long-term relationships with customers, proactively manage renewal processes, and collaborate closely with Sales and Customer Success. You will also contribute with valuable customer insights that support product development and commercial strategies.
This is a highly commercial and relationship-driven role where you combine analytical thinking with strong negotiation skills to maximize customer lifetime value and business impact.
Responsibilities

Own and manage the full renewal lifecycle for assigned customers, from early engagement to closed agreements

TL;DR You'll secure how Lovable works - the laptops, identities, SaaS apps, and AI tools 250+ Lovables use every day - without slowing anyone down.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
5+ years in corporate, enterprise, or endpoint security at a fast-growing tech company.
Deep expertise in identity (Google Workspace/Okta/Entra, SSO, SCIM, conditional access), MDM (Jamf/Kandji/Intune), and SaaS security posture (SSPM).
You can write code (Python, Bash, or Go) and treat policies as software - versioned, tested, deployed.
Strong instincts for IT risks such as phishing, social engineering, and insider risk - including the new AI-flavored variants.
Pragmatic about UX. You know when a control is real security and when it's just friction.
Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, et al).
Bonus: experience managing hardware security keys

What you'll do
Own the security of Lovable's corporate environment: identity, endpoints, SaaS, email, and the AI tools we live in.
Roll out and maintain controls that scale - passkeys, device trust, conditional access, DLP, SSPM.
Run phishing, awareness, and tabletop programs that actually change behavior.
Work on Detection & Response to make detection of insider and account-takeover risk first-class.
Secure and optimise our diverse AI toolstack, including Lovable itself, working closely with the product team on feedback and iterations
Help the Security and GRC teams make least-privilege the default and auditability free.
Ensure the right data is surfaced to the right people, while implementing data classifications and reducing the risk of data loss

Our Stack
Devices: macOS, Linux, Kandji, Crowdstrike
Networking: Tailscale, Cloudflare, Meter, Unifi
IAM: Google Workspace, Okta, Entra
Dev tools/data: Lovable, GitHub, BigQuery, various AI tools

About Comsys
Comsys AB is a Swedish cleantech company based in Lund, developing advanced solutions for power quality and energy efficiency. Our products help industries and critical infrastructure use electricity more reliably and efficiently, addressing complex challenges such as harmonics, resonance, flicker and load imbalance.
At the heart of our technology is our patented Active Dynamic Filtering (ADF) technology. With more than 20 years of experience and customers in over 50 countries, Comsys is continuously pushing the boundaries of power electronics and developing high-performance solutions for demanding industrial applications.
At Comsys, engineering is at the core of what we do. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment,collaborating across disciplines such as software, electronics, FPGA and systems engineering to turn complex technology into robust, high-performance products.
https://comsys.se

The role
As an Electronics Development Engineer, you will play an important role throughout the entire product development lifecycle – from early concepts and circuit design to prototype verification, industrialization, and product support.
This is a hands-on role where you will combine engineering knowledge with practical problem-solving. You will work closely with colleagues across hardware, software, systems, and mechanical engineering to turn ideas into robust, high-performance products.

Developing electronic hardware for our power electronics products

Designing electronics at circuit, PCBA, and PCB level

Designing, building, and verifying prototypes

Performing laboratory work, measurements, testing, and troubleshooting

Working with EMC design and verification

Collaborating closely with system, software, and mechanical engineers

Applying relevant IEC standards and supporting CE compliance

Who you are
You are an engineer who enjoys understanding how things work – and then making them work better. You are comfortable moving between schematic design, the lab, measurements, debugging, and discussions with colleagues from other disciplines.
You take ownership of your work, enjoy solving technical challenges, and are not afraid to get hands-on when a prototype does not behave as expected. You combine analytical thinking with a practical mindset and communicate effectively in an international environment.

An M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related field

Hands-on experience with laboratory work, testing, measurements, and troubleshooting

More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.
